example.title: Menasha City Hall & Fire Station, 124 Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-306 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,70-MENA,2-)

brief: Two-storey cream-brick city hall and fire station of 1885 by Appleton architect Charles Hove (altered 1924-1961), the oldest surviving city hall in the Fox River Valley. The narrow street front has three round-arched ground-floor openings (two former engine doors and an entrance), large arched upper windows with louvred tympana, a corbelled string course and three small pointed gables with finials on the parapet; the long plain brick side wall carries an iron fire escape. Stands between a 1950s brick annex and a modern office block in a paper-mill city.
